title: SOTA 3 Public Triad Models Empirical Replication Benchmark

model_1_protectai_deberta_v3.name: ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 v2
model_1_protectai_deberta_v3.paper_anchor: He et al. (ICLR 2023 [[11]]) & Protect AI Report 2024
model_1_protectai_deberta_v3.key_findings: High accuracy on standard direct injection (100%) and zero overdefense on SQL injection (FPR=0%). Vulnerable to Leetspeak (0%) and Base64 (0%) without Tier-0 Preprocessing.

model_2_smoothllm_neurips2023.name: SmoothLLM

tradeoff_analysis.algorithmic_principle: Perturb prompt N times and take majority vote to break brittle adversarial suffixes (GCG).
tradeoff_analysis.theoretical_defense_guarantee: Effective against transfer attacks and white-box GCG token optimization.
tradeoff_analysis.operational_bottleneck: Requires 5x downstream LLM inference calls, increasing total latency by ~5x.

model_2_smoothllm_neurips2023.key_findings: Random character perturbations break fragile gradient-based GCG suffixes in ~0.18ms on CPU. However, requiring N=5 to 10 downstream LLM forward passes multiplies API costs and latency by 5x-10x.

model_3_jailbreakbench_neurips2024.name: JailbreakBench (JBB-Behaviors)
model_3_jailbreakbench_neurips2024.key_findings: Standard 100 harmful behaviors cover 10 distinct harm categories. A pure Prompt Injection classifier flags 0% of raw harmful behaviors, demonstrating the critical necessity of multi-class distinction (Injection vs Jailbreak Intent) in PI-Guard.
